rationale: A defensible rank-blend of the archive's best alpha leg with its best slope leg, but the two legs are far less independent than claimed — capx sits in the denominator of leg one and the numerator of leg two, and dp appears in both — so much of the "restraint" information is already embedded in the coverage ratio, and the restraint leg's near-zero FF5 alpha (0.003, t=0.29) makes dilution as likely as improvement.

The stated justification is factually wrong ("all three legs share no variables" — capx, dp, sale and invt recur across legs), the nested SUMRANK silently weights the funding leg 50% versus 25% each for the others despite a hypothesis of three co-equal conditions, and the construct is the existing "Financing discipline plus operating utilization" (fmb 3.98, alpha 4.6%) plus an FF5-spanned third leg, so it is closer to a cosmetic extension than a new mechanism.

Testing MIN versus SUMRANK aggregation on identical economic content is a legitimate, non-affine design question with prior evidence that MIN works on well-measured legs, though a three-way minimum is fragile — the score is set by whichever z-score is noisiest, and one of the three legs (replacement-adjusted capex) has no standalone alpha.

target_name: Unadjusted cash earnings cover of commitments
rationale: A clean, well-motivated ablation that isolates whether the accrual adjustment still earns its keep once maturing debt enters the denominator, and it is distinct from the archive's lct-denominator version, though the stated hypothesis (accrual inflation is "offset" by short-term debt) is hand-waving and the honest framing is diagnostic rather than a new economic mechanism.

The redundancy logic is genuinely non-affine and interesting, but because the cash-stock leg is bounded below at zero while the flow leg is frequently negative, the MIN will select the flow leg for most firms and the signal risks collapsing into the archive's existing "Flow-only cover of capex and maturing debt" (fmb 3.38, alpha 4.8%); the absence of WINSOR on ratios with a potentially near-zero capx+dlc denominator is an additional construction defect relative to the rest of the family.

A single-leg substitution into the archive's best joint-evidence composite is incremental, but it is a targeted test of which numerator pairs better with the utilization channel and it materially raises panel coverage, so it earns a slot despite being a variant rather than a new mechanism.
